caption: The drawing depicts a richly patterned textile, possibly a cloth or tapestry, draped with its edges overlapping. The textile is composed of a repeating diamond pattern, bordered with red chevron lines and black outlines. Within each diamond, there are alternating designs: some contain multi-petaled floral motifs in red, green, and yellow tones, while others feature intricate geometric stitching in light blue and beige. The textile has a prominent fringe along two visible edges and a portion of a third, consisting of thick strands in shades of red and beige. The cloth sits against a plain, off-white background, emphasizing the detailed embroidery and the vibrant colors of the textile. Near the bottom right, a signature reading "Erwin Schwarz" appears.
title: Table Scarf
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
